# upwind_threat_rule_definition (Resource)

Manages an Upwind threat rule definition: a Rego expression that detects a threat, attachable to one or more threat policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A rule definition holds the detection logic. It exists on its own and can be
# attached to any number of policies, so write it once and reuse it.
resource "upwind_threat_rule_definition" "waf_deletion" {
  name            = "detect-waf-deletion"
  engine          = "rego"
  threat_category = "cloud_trail_logs"

  # The rule expression must satisfy two requirements:
  #   1. it defines is_violated(input_item)
  #   2. its package name ends with the threat_category set above
  rule_expression = <<-REGO
    package policy.custom.cloud_trail_logs

    is_violated(input_item) if {
        input_item.eventName == "DeleteWebACL"
    }
  REGO

  metadata = {
    detection_title       = "WAF Web ACL Deleted"
    detection_description = "A WAF Web ACL was deleted, removing request filtering"

    # Optional MITRE ATT&CK mapping.
    mitre_tactic_code    = "TA0005"
    mitre_technique_code = "T1562"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `engine` (String) Detection engine. Only `rego` is supported. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.
- `metadata` (Attributes) Display and MITRE ATT&CK metadata for detections raised by this rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `name` (String) Rule definition name.
- `rule_expression` (String) Rego expression body. Must begin with a package declaration matching `package policy.custom.<threat_category>`. Re-validated upstream on every change.
- `threat_category` (String) Threat category this rule detects. One of `k8s_audit_logs`, `network_traffic`, `process_execution`, `file_events`, `cloud_trail_logs`, `syscall_event`, `azure_activity_logs`, `azure_entra_id_logs`, `gcp_audit_logs`, `api_events`. Immutable: changing it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) ISO8601 timestamp when the rule definition was created.
- `creator_id` (String) ID of the user or client that created this rule definition.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this rule definition (server-generated). Maps to the API's `rule_definition_id`.
- `last_modifier_id` (String) ID of the user or client that last modified this rule definition.
- `update_time` (String) ISO8601 timestamp when the rule definition was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `detection_description` (String) Description shown on a detection.
- `detection_title` (String) Title shown on a detection, e.g. `Unauthorized API Call Detection`.

Optional:

- `mitre_tactic_code` (String) MITRE ATT&CK tactic code, e.g. `TA0001`.
- `mitre_tactic_name` (String) MITRE ATT&CK tactic name, e.g. `Initial Access`.
- `mitre_technique_code` (String) MITRE ATT&CK technique code, e.g. `T1078`.
- `mitre_technique_name` (String) MITRE ATT&CK technique name, e.g. `Valid Accounts`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Rule definitions import by their server-generated id.
terraform import upwind_threat_rule_definition.waf_deletion crd-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
